info.title: owl - API documentation generator and website builder for .NET
info.description: API documentation generator and website builder for .NET

commands.name: build
commands.description: Write it, then export a static site

options.name: --out
options.description:
Model directory for gen and serve (default .owl/json)
Site directory for build (default .owl/site)

options.name: --json
options.description: Reuse an existing model instead of generating one

options.name: --docs
options.description:
Authored markdown pages (default docs/api, when it exists)
Without them the site is browsed by namespace alone

options.name: --name
options.description: Site name

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help

options.name: --version
options.description:
Print owl's version
Model options, for what the documentation is generated from:

options.name: --tfm
options.description:
Which framework to document, for a project that multi-targets
(default net8.0); a project that targets one is documented as it is

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Build configuration MSBuild evaluates under (default Debug)

options.name: --repo-root
options.description: Root that recorded source paths are relative to (default: git root)

options.name: --examples
options.description:
Extra root for <code source="..."/> paths, tried before the project
directory and the repo root

options.name: --skip-msbuild
options.description: Reuse previously captured project inputs

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Skip the restore pass before capturing inputs

options.name: --no-build-refs
options.description:
Reuse referenced projects as they were last built, rather than
building them; much faster where they are already there

options.name: --verify
options.description:
Report undocumented public API and unresolved crefs; non-zero exit
on unresolved crefs or compilation errors

options.name: --verbose
options.description:
Full diagnostics
Site options, for serve and build:

options.name: --port
options.description: Port for serve (default 8080)

options.name: --base
options.description: Path prefix the site will be served under

options.name: --site-url
options.description: Origin for canonical urls and the sitemap

options.name: --logo
options.description: Header icon, overriding <docs>/logo.svg

options.name: --logo-dark
options.description: Header icon for the dark theme; without one, --logo covers both

options.name: --source-refs
options.description: Root for "declared in" references; without it there are none

options.name: --api-versions
options.description: without it there is no picker and <since> filters nothing

options.name: --link
options.description:
Site documenting a referenced assembly, so its types link rather than
sitting there as text. Repeatable; <asm> may end in '*'

options.name: --d2
options.description: The d2 binary that draws diagrams (default: d2 on PATH)

options.name: --skip-undocumented
options.description: Leave anything with no <summary> out of the site

options.name: --sandcastle
options.description: Also answer the Sandcastle urls this set was published at

options.name: --docify
options.description: Also answer the docify urls this set was published at

options.name: --quiet
options.description:
Only print the summary, not per-page progress (build)
serve and build generate before they render, so both take the model options too.
Requires a .NET SDK (8.0 or newer) to generate, and node (18 or newer) to serve or export.
Diagrams additionally need the d2 binary; without it a diagram fence stays a code block.
